item.title: Parliament marks 4 years of Ukraine war with service
item.description: The Danish Parliament will hold a church service at Holmens Kirke in Copenhagen on February 24 to support Ukraine, marking the four-year anniversary of Russia’s full-scale invasion. King Frederik, Queen Mary, and Ukrainian Ambassador Andrii Yanevskyi will attend. Speeches will be delivered by Speaker Søren Gade, Foreign Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen, and the Ambassador. item.title: Venstre wants to cut aid for countries that refuse to accept asylum seekers rejected by Denmark.
item.description: Venstre party leader Troels Lund Poulsen proposes reducing Denmark’s development aid from 0.7% to 0.5% of gross national income. The party intends to cut or remove aid for countries that refuse to accept their own citizens whose asylum applications have been rejected by Denmark. Poulsen also suggests reviewing funding for multilateral UN organizations. This initiative […]

item.title: Where to watch foreign language movies with English subtitles in Denmark?
item.description: Denmark has no shortage of international cinema, but English subtitles are not always guaranteed. Many mainstream cinemas prioritize Danish subtitles, leaving non-Danish speakers searching for alternatives. Art-house cinemas and selected theatres have stepped in to fill that gap. These venues make it possible to experience global films and performances without the language barrier.

item.title: “Try to be at home in Denmark. Give it some effort and you will be rewarded”: how a 62-year-old Dane and a 23-year-old international launched a podcast together
item.description: She is a language teacher, and he is a student. Together, they created a podcast to give internationals a voice. “We’re hoping that it builds a positive spiral,” they say.

item.title: Novo Nordisk wins EU approval for higher Wegovy dose
item.description: The European Commission has granted final approval for a higher injectable dose of the weight-loss drug Wegovy. The approval allows for a weekly 7.2 mg dose for adults with severe obesity. Previously, the maximum dose in the EU was 2.4 mg. Doctors can now prescribe the 7.2 mg dose as three simultaneous 2.4 mg injections. […]

item.title: Most high school students admit AI cheating in survey
item.description: A report from the Danish Evaluation Institute (EVA) reveals that AI cheating is widespread in Danish high schools.
